m4a1_peo_side.about: an M4A1 carbine, flat-top, from its right side, the muzzle to the right
m4a1_peo_side.license: public domain: a work of the US Federal Government (17 USC 105)

scale.how: the RIS top rail's teeth: 16 tooth edges over 15 slots of 0.394 in (MIL-STD-1913)

notes: the stock at its second position: the photo's length, 30.6 in, is the M4's 29.75 in plus one 0.8125 in step
the optic is an M68 CCO red dot on its own mount: the red_dot attachment is the same class, not that model
the photo shows the gun's right side; the magazine is a GI aluminium 30-rounder
